The phrase 'placing the property at the disposal of the Trust' does not signify that the Government had divested itself of its title to the property and transferred the same to the Trust.

matched_patterns.why_matched: The fact that the Trust repaid the loan from the Government for the market's construction does not alter the legal position regarding ownership, which is determined by the statute and the governing agreement.
